_说明: 从 A 级来源里拆出来的词句零件。键 = 用来在提示词里认出这条的小写片段；出处由 建库.py 自动数（在几条 A 级来源里出现过）。招牌 = BUNNY 作者（JOKER141 / FourBunny）演示提示词里的 16 个招牌写法之一（只收短语，原文不随仓库发布），检查时要数够。用的时候整句搬，只换人名、武器、颜色、场景物件。

运镜.词句: Extreme low-angle camera starting with a static close-up of <Subject 1>.
运镜.中文: 极低角度，从静止特写起
运镜.适合: 开场第一镜；下一秒接爆发

运镜.词句: the camera cuts to a dynamic tracking shot (circling <Subject 1> and <Subject 4>).
运镜.适合: 近身快打；一对一时加 circling

运镜.词句: the camera cuts to a fast low side-tracking shot.
运镜.适合: 贴地三连斩这一镜；一段里最多用一次，别整段锁侧面

运镜.词句: the camera cuts to a wide-angle low angle with a high-altitude diving crane shot.
运镜.中文: 广角低机位加高空俯冲摇臂
运镜.适合: 腾空、剑气从上往下轰；一起跃起用 rising crane shot

运镜.词句: the camera orbits 360 degrees rapidly around <Subject 1>, then instantly cuts to a facial close-up.
运镜.中文: 360 度快速环绕后切脸部特写
运镜.适合: 每段一次，放在第 7 秒左右；整段唯一的脸

运镜.词句: Cold close-up locking on her face, eyes scanning enemies.
运镜.中文: 冷脸特写锁住脸，眼睛扫视
运镜.适合: 紧跟 360 环绕；只写眼神，不写细微表情

运镜.词句: the camera cuts to a vertical rapid falling shot, freezing at the moment of impact.
运镜.中文: 垂直下坠镜头，定格在冲击瞬间

运镜.词句: the camera freezes on a close-up of the blade: a sweep of crimson metallic glow dominates the frame, signifying an explosion of killing intent.
运镜.中文: 定格刀身特写，刀光占满画面，杀意爆发
运镜.适合: 开场拔刀；一对一改成两刀相撞特写定格

运镜.词句: the camera cuts to a slow pull-back wide establishing shot, stable framing.
运镜.中文: 缓慢拉远大全景，构图稳定

运镜.词句: the camera cuts to a high-angle wide shot looking down past <Subject 1> toward the clouds.
运镜.中文: 从人物身后往下俯拍大全景

运镜.词句: the camera cuts to a tracking shot falling alongside the two fighters in mid-air.
运镜.中文: 空中跟着两人一起下坠的跟拍

运镜.词句: the camera cuts to a fast spiraling push-in as they rush at each other again.
运镜.适合: 段尾再次冲撞、锁刀（k3b 用过）

招式.词句: Within the first 1 second, she instantly bursts from a still state into a supersonic dash.
招式.中文: 一秒内从静止瞬间超音速冲出
招式.适合: 开场爆发；一对一写 both burst forward at the same instant in a supersonic charge

招式.词句: <Subject 1> dodges with zero lag; deflects each one with zero lag, every block throwing a spray of sparks.
招式.中文: 零延迟闪开 / 零延迟一一格开，每次格挡溅火花
招式.适合: 近身快打的防守；一对一用 deflects，别用 grazing her body

招式.词句: She dashes low to the ground, leaving multiple afterimages.
招式.中文: 贴地冲刺留下多道残影

招式.词句: She executes three ultra-high-speed strikes with her Tachi—horizontal slash, upward thrust, spinning cut.
招式.中文: 三连超高速斩：横斩、上挑、旋斩
招式.适合: 反击；一定写出三个具体招式名

招式.词句: <Subject 1> pushes off the ground into the air in one fluid motion, no lingering in mid-air.
招式.中文: 一气呵成蹬地腾空，不在空中停留

招式.词句: Her body flips crisply, and the Tachi cuts an extremely sharp scarlet arc.
招式.中文: 利落翻身，刀划出锋利红弧

招式.词句: She pivots in mid-air to dodge, seamlessly transitioning into a supersonic close-range thrust, piercing through the enemy formation like an arrow.
招式.中文: 空中转身闪避，接超音速近身突刺，像箭穿阵

招式.词句: Extreme agility display: wall-kicking for leverage, mid-air direction changes, teleport-like dashes.
招式.中文: 蹬墙借力、空中变向、瞬移冲刺

招式.词句: <Subject 1> hard-blocks a heavy strike, instantly dissipates the force and counters.
招式.中文: 硬接重击，瞬间卸力反击
招式.适合: 硬接反击；配垂直下坠定格

招式.词句: She bends backward under it by a hair, the flame wave sweeping just over her face and severing a few strands of silver hair.
招式.中文: 下腰毫厘躲过，焰浪擦脸削断几缕头发
招式.适合: 闪避；打空的招要砍到身后环境

招式.词句: She spins and strikes his blade near the hilt, knocking the jian out of his hand; it spins through the air and stabs into <道具>.
招式.中文: 旋身砍在剑柄附近把剑打飞，剑旋转插进某物
招式.适合: 缴械；写清打的是剑不是人（C3 验证有效）

招式.词句: Brief slow-motion as their blades lock and grind against each other, crimson and purple light pressing face to face.
招式.中文: 两刀相抵磨刃，慢动作，红紫光脸对脸
招式.适合: 一对一快打中间的停顿

招式.词句: They pass each other in mid-air three times, blades crashing, each clash sending a ring of shockwave rippling outward through the clouds below.
招式.中文: 空中交错三次，每次相撞荡开一圈冲击波

招式.词句: <Subject 1> dives at <Subject 4> head first like a crimson arrow, her Tachi thrust forward at supersonic speed.
招式.中文: 头朝下像红箭一样俯冲刺过去
招式.适合: 空中压下去的一击；对方要写成横剑挡住

招式.词句: Both burst forward at the same instant in a supersonic charge.
招式.中文: 两人同时爆发冲向对方
招式.适合: 一对一开场或再次冲撞

后果.词句: the ground beneath her feet cracks and collapses continuously in a chain reaction, with debris and dust violently ejecting outward due to high-speed airflow.
后果.中文: 脚下地面连锁塌陷，碎石尘土被高速气流喷出
后果.适合: 冲刺；“快”画不出来，后果画得出来

后果.词句: the stone tiles crack and lift in two chains racing toward each other, dust and leaves blasting outward.
后果.中文: 石砖裂成两串相向而来，尘土落叶炸开

后果.词句: Her silver-white long hair and the hem of her white robe are pulled straight back by wind pressure, creating a sharp, knife-edge silhouette.
后果.中文: 风压把头发衣摆拉直，刀锋般的剪影

后果.词句: tearing enemy armor into fragments with dense sparks flying.
后果.中文: 盔甲被撕成碎片，火花四溅
后果.适合: 砍中敌兵/怪物（不要用在要活着的对手身上）

后果.词句: the ground cracking in a ring beneath her feet.
He is pushed sliding backward across the tiles in a long trail of sparks, his heels gouging two grooves in the stone.
后果.中文: 滑退拖出长长火花，脚跟在石头上犁出两道沟
后果.适合: 被震退（一对一打不死的对手用这个代替砍中）

后果.词句: a stone pillar behind him is sliced cleanly in half and slides apart, crashing onto the floor in a burst of dust.
后果.中文: 身后石柱被整齐劈成两半，滑开砸地扬尘
后果.适合: 打空的招砍到环境；先确认这件道具后面不用

后果.词句: a visible shockwave rippling across the terrace.
<Subject 1> lands heavily, dust and debris scattering.
后果.中文: 重重落地，尘土碎石散开

特效.词句: The sword moves so fast it weaves a sharp net of red light.
特效.中文: 刀快到织成一张红光网

特效.词句: She releases a cone-shaped sword qi (red energy) storm, vertically bombing the enemy below.
特效.中文: 放出锥形剑气风暴，垂直轰下

特效.词句: Mystical runes suddenly unfold around her, a spiritual impact wave blasting through the scene.
特效.中文: 符文突然展开，灵力冲击波扫过全场
特效.适合: 特写蓄力那一镜的结尾

特效.词句: swinging a giant crescent-shaped world-destroying sword qi, frontally tearing through the entire battlefield.
特效.中文: 挥出巨大新月剑气，正面撕开整个战场
特效.适合: 终结大招；一对一时写成擦过对手、劈开他身后的东西

特效.词句: Only red sword-light afterimages remain across the battlefield.
特效.中文: 战场上只剩红色剑光残影

特效.词句: crimson and purple light clash in a burst of sparks that dominates the frame.
特效.中文: 红紫光相撞，火花占满画面

节奏.词句: Brief slow-motion emphasizes the contrast of extreme speed, then the rhythm instantly doubles.
节奏.中文: 短暂慢动作衬出极速，然后节奏瞬间翻倍
节奏.适合: 每段至少一次，放在近身快打里

节奏.词句: high-frequency camera shake, intense and violent impact.
节奏.中文: 镜头高频震动，冲击猛烈

收尾与眼神.词句: She raises her eyes, locking onto the depths of the darkness with a cold gaze.
收尾与眼神.中文: 抬眼冷冷盯住黑暗深处

收尾与眼神.词句: Her white hair and robe flap violently in the wind, killing intent continuously rising.
收尾与眼神.中文: 衣发在风里猛烈翻飞，杀意不断升起

声音.词句: Sharp metallic Tachi unsheathing and clashing sounds.
Dense red sword qi whistling and air-tearing noises.
The soundscape is dominated by high-speed whooshes, sharp metallic impacts, and low-frequency booms from energy releases and ground destruction.
声音.中文: 高速呼啸、金属撞击、低频爆炸为主
